Sara 

Appreciate the clear list  below is a short recap and the materials we've attached. I'm looping in Marissa (Sales Eng) and Rishi (Security) to confirm the finer legal/security language and to kick off the vendor questionnaire.

Quick answers (summary):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II attestation for the period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Attestation attached (Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf).
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA for Dedicated and Private deployments; we can execute a BAA for customers on Dedicated or Private plans. For hosted (public API) we handle PHI on a case-by-case basis and recommend Private deployment for regulated PHI workloads.
- GDPR: We have standard data processing addenda for EU customers and can provide SCCs where required.
- Data deletion / retention (hosted defaults):
  * Primary customer data (customer inputs and derived artifacts): removed from live systems within 30 days of a verified deletion request.
  * Backups / snapshots: retained up to 90 days by default; backup rotation means data may persist in backups for up to 90 days before permanent purge.
  * Permanent purge from immutable/archive tiers may take up to 180 days in exceptional cases (we'll raise if your policy requires stricter guarantees).
- Logs: default request/log retention is 90 days; configurable up to 12 months for enterprise customers. Audit logging for admin activity is retained per account settings and can be exported on request.

Attachments I've included:
- Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (attestation)
- data_retention_policy_summary.pdf (summary of retention/deletion/backup policy)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Amaya.docx (VSQ template)  feel free to start this and we'll route to Rishi for answers.

Proposed next steps:
1) Mark whether you need a BAA for this engagement. If yes, we'll route Legal to draft.
2) Confirm whether the 90-day backup retention is acceptable or whether you require a shorter hard limit.
3) We can complete the VSQ within ~7-10 business days once received (longer if overnight legal review required).
4) If helpful, Rishi can do a 30-minute security deep-dive next week to review encryption, KMS, and log retention.

If you need us to propose specific SLA language for contract redlines, we can draft sample contract language for deletion SLAs and backup retention.

Thanks  happy to tighten anything above.

Best,

Subject: Internal: Amaya retention clarifications

Neha / Rishi 

Quick internal note to align on what we should commit to in sales language:
- Commit publicly: primary data removal from live systems within 30 days of request.
- Backups: default retention window 90 days; we can offer contractual cap of 90 days for Hosted customers. For Dedicated/Private, we can set shorter retention per customer policy (30/60/90) depending on storage choices.
- Log retention: default 90 days; configurable up to 12 months for an enterprise add-on.
- Permanent purge: call out that deletions from cold/archived backups may have up to a 180-day window in specific architectures  we should only commit to 90 days unless Legal approves otherwise.

Action items for the thread:
1) Rishi: please review the attached retention summary and SOC2 and confirm we can offer a 90-day contractual cap for backups for Amaya.
2) Neha: propose the VSQ link back to Sara and offer the security deep-dive meeting.

Thanks  I suggest we include the proposed SLA bullet points in the contract exhibit and keep the 180-day note as an internal exception (avoid in the exhibit unless Legal signs off).

 Marissa

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments  I reviewed the SOC 2 and the retention summary and looped in procurement. A couple of clarifications before we start the procurement paperwork:

- BAA: we do require a BAA for PHI. Please route to Legal; procurement will need a signed BAA before final approval.
- Backup retention: Amaya requires a maximum 90-day retention on backups (we're comfortable with 90 days but cannot accept >90 days). Please confirm you can contractually cap backups at 90 days for our account.
- Logs: default 90 days is acceptable; can you confirm how we export logs if we need to store them in our SIEM?
- VSQ: please send the Vendor Security Questionnaire link (or the doc) and an expected turnaround. We'd like the VSQ completed in ~10 business days if possible.

If you can confirm the 90-day backup contractual cap and route the BAA draft, procurement will start the PO paperwork. Also, we'll take you up on the security deep-dive  can your team do a 30-minute call next week (any day except Thu)?
